booth.label.noBeat: Babu bugun da za a bi
booth.alt: Nora a teburin DJ a Club Shape: na’urorin kunna kiɗa biyu da mahaɗi a kan dandamali, tare da fitilu da jama’a
booth.unsupported: Wannan na’urar ba za ta iya gudanar da rumfar ba: tana buƙatar WebGL 2.
booth.failed: Rumfar ta kasa farawa a wannan na’urar.
booth.exampleNote: Ana ƙirƙirar waƙoƙin saitin misali a na’urarka, kuma an tsara haɗin Nora a kan bugunsu. Ba watsa shirye-shiryen Shape Radio ba ne.
club.cardLine: Nora a babban zaure, tebura da ɗakunan zama, mashaya, da tafkunan ninƙaya da filayen wasa a waje.
club.eyebrow: Wurin taro na kama-da-wane na Shape
club.intro: Nora tana kiɗa a babban zaure. Zagaya filin rawa, zauna a tebur, hau zuwa ɗakin zama ko ɗaki na musamman, shiga falon hutu da mashaya, ko fita waje zuwa tafkunan ninƙaya da filayen wasa.
club.closed: Hotunan kulob ɗin ba su loda ba. Duba haɗin intanet ɗinka, sannan ka sake buɗewa.
club.failed: Hoton wannan ɗakin bai loda ba. Zaɓi wani, ko ka sake gwadawa.
club.note: Ɗakunan da harabar hotuna ne na Club Shape, waɗanda aka yi da AI. Ba watsa shiri kai tsaye ba ne, kuma babu abin da ke cikinsu da ake sayarwa.
club.liveNote: Wannan shi ne ɗakin 3D kai tsaye. Idan tashar ba ta kan iska, Nora tana kunna misalin saiti da aka yi wa alama; idan tana kan iska, tana motsi da abin da ake kunnawa.
club.alt.arrival: Club Shape daga titi da dare: gini mai lanƙwasa da barandodi masu haske da itatuwan dabino, alamarsa a saman ƙofar shiga, da hasumiyoyin birni a bayansa
club.alt.atrium: Dukan zauren daga barandar baya: filin rawa cike da mutane har zuwa allon da ya kai girman bangon ƙarshe mai rubutun Club Shape, itatuwan dabino a kan barandodi, da alwatika biyu a rufin da suke buɗe ga gine-ginen birni
club.alt.floor: Filin rawa yana fuskantar dandali: Nora a wurin kiɗa ƙarƙashin allon da ya cika bangon ƙarshe, tebura da aka killace da igiya a hannun dama na wurin kiɗan, da fitilun alwatika da aka saukar daga rufi
club.alt.decks: Nora a na’urorin kiɗa, da belun kunne a kanta, taron jama’a a bayanta
club.alt.booth: Zauren daga bayan Nora: na’urorin kiɗa, taron jama’a, barandodi da gine-ginen birni ta rufin
club.alt.tables: Tebur a kan dandamalin da ke hannun dama na wurin kiɗa, da kwalabe a cikin ƙanƙara, yana kallon dandali ta saman taron jama’a
club.alt.balcony: Ɗakin zama a baranda, yana kallon filin rawa da dandali daga sama
club.alt.suite: Ɗaki na musamman mai kujeru masu laushi da mashayarsa, a bayan bangon gilashi a saman babban zaure
club.alt.lounge: Falon VIP: bangon dutsen onyx mai haske, benci na karammiski da kujeru masu laushi ƙarƙashin fitilu masu ado
club.alt.bar: Mashayar kwakteyl: kanta ta dutse mai haske, bango cike da kwalabe da alamar Shape ta neon
club.alt.grounds: Club Shape da harabarsa daga sama a rana mai haske: tafkunan ninƙaya, filayen tanis, filayen padel da hanyar gudu a tsakanin itatuwan dabino, da birni a baya
club.alt.pool: Tafkin ninƙaya a rana mai haske, da kujerun hutawa da laima, ana kallon Club Shape a ƙetaren ruwa
club.alt.courts: Wasan padel a rana mai haske, a gefen filayen tanis, da Club Shape a baya
club.alt.track: Masu gudu a hanyar gudu ta waje a rana mai haske, da filayen wasa da Club Shape a baya
club.alt.sunset: Club Shape a faɗuwar rana, ana kallonsa ta kan tafki da filayen wasa, fitilunsa na fara haskawa
hr.noPulse: Babu bugun zuciya · haɗa na'urar lura
prompt.body: Rediyo zai kunna a baya — lokacin motsa jiki, shirya abinci, ko duk lokacin da manhajar a buɗe take. Koyaushe babu talla. Kana iya dakatarwa a kowane lokaci.
